\par\smallskip
\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize Baseline IDEO $=(\bar R-\bar L)/(\bar R+\bar L)$ on the cross-model means, missing if $\bar R$ or $\bar L$ is missing. Variants: within each model, a missing right or left score is set to 0 when the other component is present (both missing: the model does not contribute). Variant 1: $(R_m-L_m)/(R_m+L_m)$ within model, averaged over the contributing models. Variant 2: the ratio on the means of $R_m$ and $L_m$ over the contributing models. Column (4): POP and IDEO, country and year fixed effects; column (5): with POP $\times$ IDEO; column (7): column (5) with party fixed effects (CMP party code). ME: marginal effect of POP in column (5) at the 10th and 90th percentile of the respective measure over all manifestos. Standard errors clustered by party (CMP party code) in parentheses; *** p$<$0.01, ** p$<$0.05, * p$<$0.1 (t distribution with G$-$1 degrees of freedom). Each row uses its own complete cases.\end{minipage}
